title: Expected satisfaction of a random linear constraint
statement: Let $V$ be a finite set and consider a constraint on three distinct variables in $V$ requiring their sum in $\mathbb{F}_2$ to equal a specified right-hand side in $\mathbb{F}_2$. Under a uniformly random assignment of elements of $\mathbb{F}_2$ to $V$, the expected satisfaction indicator of this constraint is $1/2$.
hypotheses_covered: The constraint has an injective scope of three variables
The constraint specifies a right-hand side in $\mathbb{F}_2$
